hints.title: Frequency Disjunction
hints.text: A word meets the criteria if and only if its frequency is strictly one in both collections.

hints.title: Map Construction
hints.text: Tally occurrences in words1 and words2 separately with two frequency tables.

hints.title: Intersection Verification
hints.text: Iterate over keys in the first map and increment the answer when the count in both maps equals one.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: A word must have frequency exactly equal to 1 in both collections.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing words with nested loops requires O(N * M) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash maps provide linear time checks by tracking word counts in memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should construct frequency maps for both arrays and count matching keys with single occurrences.
